children: PLAYSTUDIOS announced a 1-for-10 reverse stock split effective Sept. 30, 2026 and reported $3.0M in Q3 share repurchases.
1-for-10 reverse stock split effective 5:00 p.m. ET on Sept. 30, 2026; Class A trades split-adjusted Oct. 1, 2026.
Reverse split applies equally to Class A and Class B; no change to par value, authorized shares, or relative voting rights.
Approximately 4.3 million Class A shares repurchased through Sept. 24 for $3.0M (avg ~$0.71) under Rule 10b5-1 plan.
No fractional shares issued; cash paid in lieu of fractions based on Sept. 30, 2026 closing price (post-split adjusted).
Reverse split intended to help regain compliance with Nasdaq $1.00 minimum bid price requirement; CUSIP for Class A post-split: 72815G306.
